stem: Which sentence best explains the reason for Jelissa's concern about the original project idea?

options.label: F
options.text: I know everyone decided to write a song, but now that I've had time to think about it, I'm beginning to doubt the wisdom of that decision.

options.label: G
options.text: Writing a song would be fun—especially for Jevon, since he plays an instrument and sings.

options.label: H
options.text: I think we should create a website instead.

options.label: J
options.text: We have a lot of talent in our group, but by creating only a song, we would be limiting ourselves.
